title: Album release: Tour 2003 by Ringo Starr | 2004
content:
Tour 2003, the seventh live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 23 March 2004.

It was recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the All-Starr Band at the Casino Rama in Rama, Ontario, Canada, on 24 July 2003. It was the first show by the eighth All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Tour 2003 was released by the Koch label. It did not chart.
